title: Defragmenting Language Models: An Interpretability-based Approach for Vocabulary Expansion

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring token over-fragmentation by comparing the ratio of subword tokens required to encode parallel datasets relative to English, and evaluating tokenizer efficiency (bits-per-byte) alongside downstream model performance (SIB200, Belebele benchmarks) across 14 distinct languages categorized by resource availability (high vs. low) and script type (Latin vs. non-Latin).
